prompt:
Create a polished high-fidelity MOBILE UX mockup board for Palla's UPDATED SESSION CREATION form. This is a visual proposal before UI implementation. Use the attached refined-foundations board ONLY as visual-system reference: pale lavender canvas #fbf8ff, white large cards with visible subtle 1px #e3e1ec borders and24radius, lavender #f4f2fd nested blocks16radius, dark ink #1a1b22, olive #536600 readable accents, vivid lime #d4ff00 selected highlights and main actions, Hanken Grotesk headings/body and Geist compact labels. Match the existing refined Stitch aesthetic closely; correct alignment and spacing. No phone frames, browser chrome, dark background, gradients, photographs, payment fields, price, fee, deposit, refunds, bank details, payment deadline, Palla Pay, emojis, or unrelated features.

Output ONE wide landscape design board with FIVE adjacent equal-width tall native phone artboards, ~390 logical pixels each, separated by modest lavender margins. Small outer headings: '01 · Details', '02 · Schedule', '02 · Timing options', '03 · Players', '04 · Review'. These are four steps: the two step02 panels show upper and lower scroll positions of the SAME Schedule step, not different alternatives or a fifth step. Board title small 'Palla · Create a session', footer 'Proposed mobile flow · Timing and waitlist settings are optional'. Prioritize readable screen text, accurately aligned inputs, 24px side padding, 12-16px interior grouping, 32px section separation,48px minimum action targets. Screens around900-1100px logical height as needed; all required content visible without cropping. Keep restrained compact hierarchy. Don't shrink important content or add arbitrary decoration.

Each screen compact top header back chevron, 'Create session', text action 'Save draft'. Thin unobtrusive progress indicator and small step marker. Bottom continuation action lime with clear label. No bottom navbar in creation flow.

01 DETAILS (Step1of4): title 'Session details', helper 'Give players the essentials.' White bordered24-radius card with normal left-aligned field labels and identical white bordered48-high inputs: 'Session name' value 'Saturday social padel'; 'Club' search-pin icon value 'Sunset Athletic Club', secondary address 'Av. Córdoba 1234, Buenos Aires'; 'Court' value 'Court 2'; 'Maximum players' value '4'; multiline 'Description (optional)' value 'Friendly games. Bring your racket and arrive 10 minutes early.' Google location input is an autocomplete trigger but do not add a map or API/config text. Main lime 'Continue to schedule'.

02 SCHEDULE upper scroll (Step2of4): title 'When will you play?' White bordered card: 'Date' calendar icon 'Sat 24 Oct 2026'; identical input treatments for paired 'Start' clock '18:00' and 'End' clock '19:30'; small metadata 'Buenos Aires time · 90 minutes'. Second white rounded bordered card 'Repeat' containing one-time/weekly segmented choice, Weekly selected pale lime/olive; 'Every Saturday' small; 'Series end date' calendar 'Sat 14 Nov 2026'; quiet '4 sessions will be created'. Next white card row 'Registration & cancellation' with expand chevron, subtitle 'Optional timing rules for each date'. Lower hint 'Timing options shown in the next panel'. No fabricated autosaved/cloud claims. Main lime 'Continue to players'.

02 TIMING OPTIONS lower scroll of sameStep2: title 'Registration & cancellation', helper 'Optional rules applied to every session in this series.' White bordered card with three clearly separated settings, each label+toggle and helper.
1 'Schedule registration opening' ON toggle lime; two equalheight adjacent input cells value '7' and unit dropdown 'Days'; helper 'Before each session. Otherwise opens when published.'
2 'Registration deadline' ON toggle lime; paired input '2' / dropdown 'Hours'; helper 'Before each session. Otherwise closes at session start.'
3 'Player cancellation deadline' OFF grey toggle; no populated input for off control; helper 'No advance cutoff. Players may cancel before the session starts.'
Use 24whitecardpadding and distinct dividers/subsections, not tiny toggle captions. Small note 'Registration must open before it closes.' Main lime 'Continue to players'. This remains Step2of4; no price/payment information.

03 PLAYERS (Step3of4): title 'Who can join?' Three white subtle-bordered24radius cards:
VISIBILITY card heading 'Visibility', two stacked selectable rows, Public selected using lime/olive radio and softly tinted background; subtitle 'Listed in Explore'. Private unselected; subtitle 'Not listed in Explore'. Do not promise invitation-only or link authorization, since undecided.
CATEGORIES card heading 'Allowed categories', helper 'Select any combination, or allow all categories.' 'All categories' unselected checkbox row. Eight equalheight48 chips in2rows4columns labels '1ra','2da','3ra','4ta','5ta','6ta','7ma','8va'. 6ta and7ma selected pale lime witholiveborder/check. Others white thinborder. Small '2 categories selected'. No decimal ratings, slider or Help me choose link.
WAITLIST card heading 'Enable waitlist' ON toggle lime; helper 'Players can queue when the session is full.' two stacked selectable options 'Automatic promotion' / 'Manual promotion only', Manual selected pale lime/olive radio. 'Limit queue size (optional)' ON checkbox and48px white numeric input '4'; helper 'Without a limit, the queue is unlimited.' Main lime 'Review session'.

04 REVIEW (Step4of4): title 'Ready to publish?' White bordered summary card, title 'Saturday social padel', venue/court, 'Sat 24 Oct · 18:00–19:30', dateTime/venue aligned compact icons. Lavender recap 'Weekly · Saturdays · 4 dates', small '24 Oct–14 Nov'. Separate rounded white card 'Players & access' shows clean paired label/value rows 'Visibility / Public', 'Categories / 6ta, 7ma', 'Maximum players / 4', 'Waitlist / Manual promotion · Up to4'. Another whitecard 'Timing rules': 'Registration opens / 7 days before', 'Registration closes / 2 hours before', 'Cancellation / No advance cutoff'. Small olive 'Edit' text action near each section title. Bottom checkbox with wrapped text 'I have arranged the court with the club.' checked. Helper 'Palla does not book courts for you.' Main lime 'Publish 4 sessions'. All actions48high and textwrap safe; no unavailable check-in/messaging in the creation form.

This is a native mobile form design board, with realistic editable controls and disciplined spacing. All toggles, radios and multi-select state must be visually distinct. Preserve screenshot-reference palette/fonts/card borders, but use only text requested here; ignore its fake ratings/payment/attendance examples. Do not invent payment content anywhere. Render precise legible typography and clear white/lavender tonal layering.
scope: Updated creation form; four steps with schedule expanded timing view; no payment settings; UI not implemented
notes: The schedule panel's 'next panel' hint is presentation-only and must not ship as product copy. Court value is a free-text field, not a club inventory selector.
